proposed_fixes.title: Preserve Calculator bounds when FancyZones excludes it
proposed_fixes.root_cause: The excluded-app path may stop snapping but still allow prior zone or maximize state to be reapplied.
plan: Trace excluded-app matching and placement for CalculatorApp.exe.
Ensure excluded windows receive neither zone geometry nor stale maximize state.
Add a regression case for saved normal size after exclusion.
